caption: The drawing features a single ceramic vessel in the center of the page, depicted within a lightly outlined rectangular border. The vessel has a rounded body with a narrow base and a lid that tapers to a small round knob at the top. Two short, horizontal handles are positioned symmetrically on either side of the body. The entire surface of the vessel, including the lid and handles, is decorated with wavy, horizontal stripes in a variety of colors, including shades of brown, red, green, yellow, blue, orange, and black. The stripes are irregular in both width and color distribution, with some overlap and blending visible in places. The background is plain and off-white, and the drawing has a rectangular border marked on the same off-white paper, framing the vessel. There are no additional objects or elements within the composition.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
